name: automation-mining
description: Find repeated manual work in activity records. Get automation proposals with evidence and work counts for your review.

interface.shortDescription: Find the work you keep doing by hand
interface.longDescription: Start with one work source or a set of activity records. Review up to five automation proposals with source references, distinct work counts, remaining human decisions, and unknowns. Choose what to investigate or build.
defaultPrompt: Use automation-mining to find repeated manual work in these activity records.
Use automation-mining on one work source. Ask me about my role and the time window before reading.
